name: KromiumUiFramework
summary: UI framework targets supported by Kromium for hosting OSR surfaces.

enumConstants.name: SWING
enumConstants.description: Standard Java Swing toolkit. Hosts OSR output in a native javax.swing.JPanel.

enumConstants.name: AWT
enumConstants.description: Pure Java AWT toolkit. Hosts OSR output in a native java.awt.Canvas.

enumConstants.name: SWT
enumConstants.description: Eclipse SWT toolkit. Hosts OSR output in a native org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Canvas.

enumConstants.name: JAVAFX
enumConstants.description: JavaFX toolkit. Hosts OSR output in a native JavaFX Canvas/Region.

enumConstants.name: HEADLESS
enumConstants.description: Off-screen headless rendering without a UI window hierarchy.

companionMethods.name: fromString
companionMethods.description: Resolves a framework enum by name (case-insensitive).
